goal: Generate historically plausible but non-repeating Dominic temporadas. Never copy a real torero calendar.

patterns: American winter campaigns can extend the season
injury/recovery can cancel or reshape commitments
media and television rights can affect negotiations

constraints: Never schedule Dominic in two physically impossible places.
Preserve realistic travel and recovery time.
Do not repeat an identical corrida calendar across years or saves.
Major ferias are opportunities, not guaranteed appearances.
Results and injuries must be able to alter later unsigned dates.
Signed contracts require an explicit cancellation/replacement reason to disappear.

variation.protectedCanon: Canonical life milestones remain protected while context, timing windows and lived route can vary.

generationAhead.videoRule: Pre-generate only branches whose probability and reuse justify cost; never block player for speculative generation.
